comment: JP2 0009: Suter's foreword, first page (p. [V]): Bjørnbo's unfinished work, the manuscripts of Oxford, Chartres, Paris and Madrid, Besthorn's share, the three tasks of the editor; the acceptance by the Danish society.

observations: The first page of the foreword; the page number, V by the contents, is not printed. L01 «VORWORT» in capitals, with a short rule below it. L02 opens with a large initial D, standing on the base line of the line and rising above it.

At the foot of the page, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «II» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

Spaced type (gesperrt), marked {sp:}: the names «Björnbo» (L03, L06, L11, L16), «Besthorn» (L11) and «Athelhard» (L13), and «erstens», «zweitens», «drittens» (L14, L15, L18); italics: «Oxford», «Chartres», «Paris» (L08), «Madrid» (L13), «Chartres» (L15) and «Skrifter» (L22).
The title page (JP2 0005) spells the name «BJØRNBO», with ø; the foreword prints «Björnbo», with ö.
